rationale: The description is the first surface loaded and sets the agent's framing for the entire skill. Adding the specific contract requirement here primes the agent before it ever reads the body instructions, increasing the chance the property is applied consistently across all tools.
expected_effect: Agent internalizes additionalProperties:false as a core characteristic of correct MCP servers from the outset, reducing omission on the first repeat where failures occurred.
regression_risk: Very low. Description rewrites do not alter tool logic; the five reliable-pass tasks already produce compliant servers and will continue to do so.
